posts.title: 0.9.0 is coming, and it is the last one you have to fetch by hand
posts.body: The next version can update itself, so once you have it a new build arrives inside the app rather than on the releases page. It also folds duplicate characters and places back into one, which matters if an import handed you the same person three times over, and it gives a book you delete somewhere to wait rather than going for good. Word lookup answers again as well, after the dictionary it had been relying on went quiet. The full notes go up alongside the build.

posts.title: 0.8.260 is out for Windows and macOS
posts.body: The installers cover both of the last two rounds, and the main one is that time you spent writing could go missing instead of being saved, which no longer happens.

posts.title: There is a newsletter now, if you want the longer version
posts.body: It covers writing and the building of Inkgrove at more length than a release note allows, and since it is only just beginning you would be reading from the first one.

posts.title: Videos about the craft, and about building this in the open
posts.body: There is a channel where I talk through writing and through what goes into Inkgrove, including the parts of drafting that tend to catch people out.
